title: Monotone Equilibrium, Admissibility and Perfection
abstract: arXiv:2509.01358v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper studies monotone equilibrium, admissibility, and perfection in Bayesian games. Athey (2001), McAdams (2003), and Reny (2011) prove existence of pure-strategy monotone equilibria under single-crossing and quasi-supermodularity. We construct a counterexample satisfying these assumptions but with no admissible monotone equilibrium, showing these results cannot generally be strengthened without further conditions. To address this existence problem, we introduce perfect monotone equilibrium, combining monotonicity with trembling-hand robustness. We show that stronger assumptions such as increasing differences and supermodularity ensure existence of perfect (and hence admissible) monotone equilibria. We also demonstrate the practical relevance of our results through auctions and Bertrand competitions.

translated_title: 单调均衡、容许性与完美性
translated_abstract: 本文研究贝叶斯博弈中的单调均衡、容许性与完美性。Athey（2001）、McAdams（2003）和Reny（2011）在单交叉性和拟超模性条件下证明了纯策略单调均衡的存在性。我们构造了一个满足这些假设但不存在容许单调均衡的反例，表明在缺乏进一步条件的情况下，这些结果一般无法被加强。为解决这一存在性问题，我们引入了完美单调均衡的概念，将单调性与颤抖手稳健性相结合。我们证明，诸如递增差分和超模性等更强的假设能够保证完美（从而容许）单调均衡的存在性。我们还通过拍卖和伯特兰竞争的例子展示了本文结果的实际应用价值。
tldr: 本文构造了一个满足既有存在性结果假设但不存在容许单调均衡的反例，并提出将单调性与颤抖手稳健性相结合的完美单调均衡概念，证明了在递增差分和超模性等更强假设下其存在性。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs a counterexample with no admissible monotone equilibrium despite satisfying existing existence assumptions, and introduces perfect monotone equilibrium—combining monotonicity with trembling-hand robustness—proving its existence under stronger conditions such as increasing differences and supermodularity.
